Es una mala estación de servicio entre que hay una sola porque la otra la estan haciendo viene gente con bidones en mano y se salta a todas las personas que esperamos como media hora para llenar el tanque. Y no van con un bidón hacen varios viajes para llenar su tanque. Una vergüenza

(Translated by Google)
It's a terrible gas station. There's only one because the other one is under construction, and people come in with jerrycans and cut in line, cutting in line after everyone who's been waiting for about half an hour to fill up. And they don't just use one jerrycan; they make several trips to fill their tanks. It's a disgrace.
